name: fluid_quad_gen
describe: Per fluid block, emit water/lava surface + side quads to a DefaultVertexFormats.BLOCK buffer. Faithful C port of renderFluid. VERIFIED bitwise PASS: enriched live capture (27-field record + 20-int sprite header) of 1710 water blocks -> 39060 ints, candidate matches golden bit-for-bit. Branch coverage from the capture: flow-UP, still-UP, UP back-face, 4 side faces (front+back), DOWN face (21 blocks), and water-overlay side branch (44 rows, water next to glass). Lava not present in the capture scene but is code-path-identical (same emission logic, lava sprite set spr[2]/spr[3]).
